testcase.name: a genuine share grant reads public bytes but never authorizes private GET or HEAD; the genuine owner session does
the production storage management route rejects a genuine share grant and accepts a genuine owner session
real password validation preserves spaces and case, accepts NFKC equivalents, and issues a scoped opaque Cookie
the HTTP password schema counts Unicode code points and rejects empty or overlong values without grants
the persisted grant expires at exactly 24 hours and browsing or refresh never slides its deadline
future deadline edits retain a live grant while the latest share deadline always wins
editing an already expired share revokes its grant even without a request at expiration
layout and name settings preserve authorization and return only the current public projection
setting, replacing and clearing a password keep the address and revoke every earlier grant
closing and reopening preserves the Token and requires a new password grant
rotating permanently rejects the old address and deleting cascades the share and its grants
a real process restart preserves owner sessions and the share grant without renewing either Cookie
all four anonymous entries share the same authorization boundary and never expand for an owner
share grants stay independent across albums and simultaneous verification in one album
anonymous writes reject foreign or absent origins and HTTPS configuration adds Secure to the share Cookie
refresh accepts at most 80 explicit IDs and never reveals private, trashed or unknown members
password verification races with password changes, close, expiry, Token rotation and deletion without issuing any stale grant
